description_en: Unbinds SSH key pairs from one or more Linux instances
description_zh: 为一台或者多台Linux实例解绑SSH密钥对
kebab_example: aliyun ecs detach-key-pair --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-key-pair-name testKeyPairName --instance-ids 'i-bp1d6tsvznfghy7y0000_,_i-bp1ippxbaql9zet70000_,_…_i-bp1ib7bcz07l0000' --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachKeyPair
